purpose: Freeze P/S and EV/Sales numerator, revenue denominator, PIT alignment, scope, sector guards and anti-double-count semantics before curriculum intake or outcome research.

proposedOwner.proposal: Extend D08-06 from a single EV/EBITDA label into a broader enterprise/revenue-multiple owner that can contain EV/EBITDA, EV/Sales and P/S as coordinated views rather than independent votes.

trailingPriceToSales.formula: decision-time equityMarketValue / PIT-safe trailing consolidated revenue
trailingPriceToSales.alternativeRepresentation: price / salesPerShare only when numerator/denominator share-count clocks are demonstrably aligned
guards: equityMarketValue must use decision-time eligible price and PIT-safe share-count denominator
current shares may not reconstruct historical market cap
revenue must match issuer scope and be positive/known
financial institutions use specialist branch or UNKNOWN

trailingEvToSales.formula: decision-time enterpriseValue / PIT-safe trailing consolidated revenue
guards: enterprise-value claim scope must match consolidated operating denominator
debt/cash/non-common claims must come from compatible statement vintage
lease treatment must be frozen and consistent within comparisons

forwardPriceToSales.formula: decision-time equityMarketValue / authorized PIT forecast sales
forwardPriceToSales.rule: No historical reconstruction from today's analyst estimates; requires authorized forecast vintage source.

forwardEvToSales.formula: decision-time enterpriseValue / authorized PIT forecast sales

enterpriseValue.canonicalCandidate: equity market value + interest-bearing debt + economically senior preferred/non-common claims + non-controlling interest when denominator is consolidated + other explicitly frozen financing claims - cash and cash equivalents
unresolvedComponents: exact debt taxonomy remains coupled to D08-06 EV/EBITDA work
lease-liability inclusion/exclusion requires one consistent policy
excess/non-operating investments cannot be netted unless their taxonomy is explicitly frozen
preferred/non-common claims and NCI may be unavailable historically and therefore UNKNOWN
enterpriseValue.scopeRule: If numerator represents claims on consolidated operations, denominator must use consolidated revenue. If claim-scope parity cannot be proven, EV/Sales=UNKNOWN.
enterpriseValue.timestampRule: Price/share count and financial-statement components may have different clocks; preserve each component's knownAt and only join values eligible at decision time.

quarterlyTtm.formula: sum of four compatible PIT quarterly IFRS revenue observations
quarterlyTtm.periodRule: single-quarter values only; cumulative YTD values require proven subtraction using same-scope/same-vintage compatible statements
quarterlyTtm.vintageRule: later restatements append; never overwrite the historical asOf denominator

taiwanMonthlyRevenue.role: timelier operating evidence and possible separately named monthlyRevenueTTM series
taiwanMonthlyRevenue.rule: Do not silently substitute monthly revenue for IFRS consolidated TTM revenue. Reconciliation/scope contract is required because reporting basis, entities and corrections can differ.

acquisitionDispositionBreak.rule: Consolidation-scope changes are structural-break tags. Sales growth and EV/Sales compression around M&A/disposal are not automatically organic rerating.

forwardRevenue.sourceRequirement: authorized point-in-time analyst/issuer forecast source with target period, basis, publishedAt and revision lineage

sectorGuards.financialInstitutions: Generic P/S and EV/Sales are not promoted for banks/insurers/financial holding companies; D08-18 specialist valuation applies.
sectorGuards.lowMarginDistribution: Raw sales multiples can look systematically cheap because each revenue dollar carries low margin; compare only with margin/business-model controls.
sectorGuards.negativeMarginGrowth: P/S remains numerically computable but low P/S is not proof of cheapness; path to sustainable margins/unit economics is required context.
sectorGuards.cyclicals: Peak sales can create artificially low multiples before revenue normalizes.
sectorGuards.acquisitionHeavy: Acquired revenue and acquisition debt/cash change both denominator and EV; scope-break tags required.
sectorGuards.highGrossMarginModels: Higher sustainable margins, growth and lower capital intensity can justify structurally higher sales multiples.

antiDoubleCount.psVsEvSales: Same sales denominator family; they are coordinated capital-structure views, not two independent votes.
antiDoubleCount.evSalesVsEvEbitda: Same EV numerator and overlapping operating-value mechanism; use as one multiple family with margin decomposition.
antiDoubleCount.revenueGrowth: D07-01/D07-09 own raw revenue growth/surprise. D08 only evaluates price/enterprise value relative to revenue.
antiDoubleCount.peerNormalization: D08-09 owns peer/sector normalization. Sales multiple module supplies raw PIT-safe ratios.
antiDoubleCount.marginQuality: D07-03/D07-14 own margins/unit economics; sales multiples consume these as explanatory controls.

pitClocks.revenueKnownAt: financial statement filing/firstObservedAt for IFRS revenue; monthly MOPS announcement for monthly series
pitClocks.balanceSheetKnownAt: compatible statement vintage for debt/cash/NCI/non-common claims
pitClocks.restatementRule: append-only; later corrected revenue or balance-sheet components cannot rewrite prior replay

unknownSemantics: historical share count unavailable or corporate-action denominator unproven

evidenceRole.strategyEvidence: Only after OOS/Shadow tests demonstrate stable incremental value beyond raw valuation, margins, growth, sector, capital structure and regime.

proposedMaturityTreatment: Do not change D08-06 current maturity from the structural return alone; new P/S/EV-Sales sub-capability begins evidence-wise at L0 until its source/replay implementation is proven.
